description: Put a slot on a later day of the calendar (after the week ahead, on or before situation.horizon.end): a planned piece in a few fields, whose full task the daily pass writes when its day enters the week ahead. Say why in plain words; the owner reads it. Checked against the playbook and its seven-day window; refused with why. A day inside the week ahead takes a full task instead (work_plan). It needs an act key.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it goes on the calendar, in plain words; the owner reads it.

slot.description: The slot: its key, day, kind, channel, label, subject, lever, reason, forecast and tokens.

date.description: Its day, YYYY-MM-DD: after input.horizon.week ends, on or before input.horizon.end.

forecast.description: What its metric should reach by byDay days after it goes live, on a metric in input.forecastMetrics when that list is present; null when it produces nothing measurable on its own.

label.description: The piece in two to five words, as the owner would name it on a calendar chip.

lever.description: The lever it pulls, as a short label: channel × kind × angle or audience ('Instagram carousel × the Transit set × gift buyers').

reason.description: Why it is on that day, in one plain sentence.

subject.description: What it is about: the product, offer, place, rival, audience or episode it works from, or the finished work on file it is cut from.

tokens.description: Marsell tokens it should take to make (100 tokens = 1 cent), estimated from what this kind of work cost before; null when there is nothing to estimate from.

name: slot_add
title: Slot add
